summary: On June 2, 2026, PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk, via its subsidiaries TelkomMetra (99.99%) and MDI (0.01%), signed a Share Purchase Agreement to divest 100% of AdMedika Group (452,330 shares) to Global Assistance Healthcare Singapore Pte, Ltd. (Fullerton). Terms such as price, premium, and enterprise value were not disclosed. The board described the transaction as part of Telkom's portfolio restructuring into four strategic pillars and alignment with state-owned enterprise streamlining. No advisors were named. The divestiture is expected to have no material operational impact; watch for regulatory approval from OJK and closing conditions.
